evd_title: All four LLMs answered all seven IRB ethics case queries with homogeneous responses
finding: All four LLMs answered all seven IRB ethics case queries with homogeneous responses
P: 7 health research ethics case studies (FERCAP-SIDCER handbook), IRB review queries
I: Google Bard, ChatGPT 3.5, Claude-Instant-100k, ChatGPT 4.0; single prompt with all queries
C: Expected key responses; 2 author raters with consensus; models compared with each other
O: All 4 answered 7/7 cases; all missed non-randomised design (case 4), eligibility issues (cases 1, 3), sample size (case 1); only Bard flagged placebo (case 5)
T: LLMs queried Oct-Nov 2023; FERCAP-SIDCER handbook 2012; paper 2025
